mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_version_status='CURRENT') AS current_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_version_status='SUSPECT') AS suspect_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_version_status='STALE') AS stale_count, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE source_version_status='UNVERIFIED') AS unverified_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE publication_status='PUBLISHED' AND review_status='APPROVED' AND source_version_status='CURRENT' ) AS trusted_count, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE enforcement='REQUIRED' AND owner_account_id IS NULL ) AS required_without_owner, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_status='UNREVIEWED') AS unreviewed_count FROM knowledge_cards WHERE repo_id=#{repositoryId} AND publication_status<>'ARCHIVED'
